cases.name: 6HB6
cases.title: Spec Example 6.1. Indentation Spaces
cases.yaml:
# Leading comment line spaces are
   # neither content nor indentation.
    
Not indented:
 By one space: |
    By four
      spaces
 Flow style: [    # Leading spaces
   By two,        # in flow style
  Also by two,    # are neither
  	Still by two   # content nor
    ]             # indentation.
cases.dump:
Not indented:
  By one space: |
    By four
      spaces
  Flow style:
  - By two
  - Also by two
  - Still by two

cases.name: 7BUB
cases.title: Spec Example 2.10. Node for “Sammy Sosa” appears twice in this document
cases.yaml:
---
hr:
  - Mark McGwire
  # Following node labeled SS
  - &SS Sammy Sosa
rbi:
  - *SS # Subsequent occurrence
  - Ken Griffey
cases.dump:
---
hr:
- Mark McGwire
- &SS Sammy Sosa
rbi:
- *SS
- Ken Griffey
